_lee_esto: S2/S3 (D-254, L3a de PUBLICAR, 25-oct-2026). Texto local por ruta de piscina: `parrafo` (las 9 ciudades de D-252, 40-60 palabras que responden a sus consultas de Search Console, D1/gsc/gsc-ciudades.md; Jupiter y Miramar no tienen desglose por consulta y responden a «pool builders <ciudad>») y `faq` (condados: 2 de 3 preguntas con el condado en el enunciado; las ciudades llevan su FAQ por captacion-servicios.json). Cada respuesta sale de la ruta que `enlace` nombra y la enlaza (encargo §3): permisos -> articulo de permisos, plazos -> articulo de plazos, financiacion -> /financing, coste -> /pool-cost-estimator. Ni cifras, ni plazos, ni barrios, ni autoridades (D-258). Filas T-247… de STITCH-TEXTO.md. Lo lee src/lib/local-ciudad.mjs y build-captacion-ciudades.mjs.

/services/pool-builders/pembroke-pines-f.parrafo: Looking for inground pool contractors in Pembroke Pines? We build the whole pool, not a part of it: 3D design, engineering, permits, excavation, the shell, plumbing, electrical and finishes, through to a closed permit at start-up, under one Florida pool contractor license. The same team designs the deck and the outdoor living around the water.

faq.pregunta: Who pulls the pool permit in Pembroke Pines?
faq.respuesta: We do, under our Florida pool contractor license. A new inground pool needs one building permit from the city or county office that has jurisdiction over your property; it covers the shell, the deck, the electrical work and the plumbing, each inspected at its own stage. We prepare the submittal, pull the permit and coordinate every inspection through to a closed permit at start-up.

enlace.texto: What Permits Are Required for Pool Construction in Florida?

faq.pregunta: How long does it take to build a custom pool in Pembroke Pines?
faq.respuesta: There is no single number: the calendar depends on the permit office, the season and the scope. What is fixed is the order of the phases and the cure time of concrete and plaster, which no crew can shorten. After the design is approved and the permit is submitted, you get a schedule for your own project, updated at every inspection.

enlace.texto: Pool Construction Timeline in Florida: What to Expect From Start to Finish
